subject.title: BL-ecommerce-coupons: Coupons & Promotions — specs, aislamiento y tests

question: Should the Coupons & Promotions BL block continue as the owner-approved 28-rule spin through F2, or should maintainers split it before F3/F4?
rationale: Automation cannot validate the business wording or override the owner-approved block size; F2 is explicitly human-blocking in the BL pipeline.

options.title: Continue the 28-rule F2 block
options.body: Honor the owner comment, finish bulk F2 validation, then publish the single BL PR when the specs are reviewable.

options.title: Split before isolation
options.body: Break the block into smaller sub-blocks if reviewer load is too high, at the cost of revisiting the owner’s stated grouping decision.

recommendation.title: Continue the 28-rule F2 block
recommendation.body: Honor the owner comment, finish bulk F2 validation, then publish the single BL PR when the specs are reviewable.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the assigned owner, confirmed F0/F1, and is the named blocker for F2 validation.
